channel.description: Latest articles from The College Fix (thecollegefix.com)

item.title: Indiana U. Muslims upset at random ‘Islamophobic’ X post, inaction by school officials
item.description: Muslim students at Indiana University expressed their disappointment over a social media post deemed Islamophobic, highlighting a lack of administrative acknowledgment of their experiences. They seek more recognition and support as their community grows, with calls for additional prayer spaces on campus and an emphasis on the need for attentiveness to their concerns.

item.title: Classic Learning Test expands to more than 300 schools as alternative to SAT, ACT
item.description: The Classical Learning Test is being embraced by more states and universities, offering an alternative to traditional college admissions tests like the SAT and ACT.

item.title: Purdue seeks foreign worker to coach tennis
item.description: Purdue University looks outside of the United States to find an assistant women's tennis coach.

item.title: Catholic U. denies pro-Israel student group’s speakers, citing ‘lack of balance’
item.description: Catholic University of America denied speaker requests from the Students Supporting Israel chapter on campus, citing a lack of balance in viewpoints offered. The university told The College Fix it invited the students to resubmit their proposal with broader viewpoints. Meanwhile, a free speech expert said the school should not require students to balance out […]

item.title: Princeton might start proctoring exams again for first time in over a century
item.description: Such a move would buck 133 years of precedent and 'would mark a departure from the traditionally unproctored exam format under the Honor Code.'

item.title: UC Riverside professor says ‘sexual identity’ labels ‘harm trans people’
item.description: A UC Riverside professor argues in the book 'Trans Pleasure: On Gender Liberation and Sexual Freedom' that sexual identity labels harm trans individuals by confining their experiences.

item.title: Concerns raised over some Christian colleges’ ties to abortion providers
item.description: 'More than one in seven Christian colleges and universities maintain some type of relationship with Planned Parenthood and the abortion industry': report

item.title: Trump admin cancels grants studying LGBTQ and ‘multiethnic’ comic books
item.description: NEH still lists grants on its website, however.

item.title: UVA ‘ecofeminist’ course has students listen to ‘birds,’ ‘lichen’ to understand oppression
item.description: The University of Virginia is offering an "Ecofeminist Poetry" course this spring that emphasizes the interconnectedness of women and nature, exploring how issues like colonialism and slavery relate to ecological themes.
